100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On October 20, 1926, the world witnessed significant political shifts as the government of Spain faced mounting pressure following a series of strikes and protests against Prime Minister Miguel Primo de Rivera's authoritarian regime. In the United States, the ongoing fallout from the stock market's tumultuous behavior raised concerns among investors about the stability of the economic recovery. Meanwhile, in Germany, the political landscape grew more precarious as the nation grappled with hyperinflation and the rise of extremist movements.
